sections.summary: Defines culpable homicide, murder, and their punishments. Section 302 prescribes death or life imprisonment for murder.
Defines various degrees of physical harm and their punishments.
Defines rape and prescribes punishment of life imprisonment or up to 10 years.
Defines theft and its aggravated forms with punishments.
Defines extortion and punishments up to 3 years imprisonment.
Defines robbery, dacoity and their punishments including death for dacoity with murder.
Defines dishonest misappropriation of property.
Defines criminal breach of trust by public servants and others.
Defines forgery of documents, currency, and their punishments.
Deals with adultery as a criminal offense.
Defines defamation and its exceptions and punishments.
Procedure for filing FIR at police station. Any person can file.
Police may examine witnesses during investigation.
Magistrate may authorize detention of accused for up to 15 days.
Provisions for plea bargaining in certain cases.
Procedure when contempt is committed in the face of the court.

sections.topic: Power to suspend or remit sentences
sections.summary: Government power to suspend or remit sentences.
Court may suspend sentence and release convict on bail during appeal.
High Court or Sessions Judge may grant bail.
The burden of proof lies on the person who asserts a fact.
Rules regarding oral evidence and its admissibility.
Rules regarding primary and secondary evidence of documents.
Admissibility of confessions. Confession to police not admissible under Section 25.
Physical, psychological, sexual, and economic abuse within domestic relationships.
Courts may issue protection orders, residence orders, and monetary relief.
Officers must assist victims in filing complaints and accessing shelters.
Breach of protection order punishable with imprisonment up to 1 year.

title: Nari O Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000
title_bn: নারী ও শিশু নির্যাতন দমন আইন, ২০০০

sections.summary: Punishment for trafficking and kidnapping of women and children.
Enhanced punishment for rape. Death penalty or life imprisonment.
Punishment for sexual harassment of women and children.
Punishment for causing death or injury for dowry. Death or life imprisonment.
Requirements for filing a plaint (civil suit).
Consequences of non-appearance including ex parte decree.
Procedure for execution of civil court decrees.
Court may grant temporary injunctions to prevent injury to plaintiff.

sections.topic: Courts to try all civil suits
sections.summary: Civil courts have jurisdiction to try all suits of civil nature.
Appeal lies from every original decree unless barred.
A living person can transfer property to another living person or entity.
Sale is transfer of ownership for a price. Requires registered document for immovable property over 100 taka.
Transfer of interest in property to secure payment of money.
Transfer of right to enjoy immovable property for a certain time.
Rules of succession and shares of heirs.
Requires permission of Arbitration Council for second marriage.
Procedure for divorce. Written notice to Chairman required. 90 days notice period.
Husband must maintain wife during marriage and iddat period.
Dower is payable on demand. If not fixed, proper dower applies.
Government publishes notification of intent to acquire land.
Formal declaration that land is needed for public purpose.
Collector makes award of compensation.
Person dissatisfied with award may seek reference to court.
Wages must be paid within 7 working days of the wage period.
Maximum 8 hours daily, 48 hours weekly. Annual leave of 1 day per 18 days worked.
Workers right to form and join trade unions.
Establishment and jurisdiction of labour courts for industrial disputes.
